map.均值与方差对异常值敏感，先看最大值/最小值是否为录入错误，剔除后再算；中位数与极: The mean and variance are sensitive to outliers, so first check whether the maximum/minimum is a data entry error and remove it before computing; the median and range are much less affected by a single extreme value and can be used to cross-check.
map.把历史回款周期贴入求标准差，评估现金流预测值的可靠区间。: Paste in historical collection periods to get the standard deviation and assess the reliable range of the cash flow forecast.

map.输入财务与经营数据（逗号或换行分隔），输出均值、极值、波动等管理分析指标与决策提: Enter financial and operating data (separated by commas or newlines) to output management metrics such as the mean, extremes, and fluctuation, plus decision prompts, supporting financial management, budget review, and business decisions.
map.页面只给描述统计（集中与离散），不含时间序列模型；预测需把多期结果导出后自行建模: The page gives only descriptive statistics (concentration and dispersion), with no time series model; forecasting requires exporting the multi-period results and building your own model. This tool is for getting the data clear first.
map.页面按总体口径（离差平方和除以 n）计算，适合把当前这批数据当作全部考察对象；若: The page computes on the population basis (the sum of squared deviations divided by n), which suits treating the current batch of data as the entire set under study; if you are only sampling to infer the population, switch to the unbiased estimate dividing by n−1.
map.预算复盘时把各部门月度支出贴入，用均值与极差看哪个部门超支幅度最大。: At the budget review, paste in the monthly spending of each department and use the mean and the range to see which department overspent the most.
map.：四个部门月支出均值分别为 52/48/61/45 万元，极差最大的是均值 61: : The mean monthly spending of the four departments is 52/48/61/45 (in ten thousand CNY); the largest range belongs to the department with a mean of 61 (lowest 38, highest 96). A large range means spending was bunched, so the approval rhythm should be made even month by month instead of concentrated at the end of the quarter.
map.：改进前单位成本中位数 21.4 元、改进后 19.8 元，同时标准差由 3.6: : Before the improvement the median unit cost was 21.4 CNY and after it is 19.8 CNY, while the standard deviation fell from 3.6 to 1.9; the median and the dispersion both dropping means the improvement came from the process as a whole rather than from a particular batch.
